disclaimer: Fictional policy for the Saboot demo. QuickDrop is not a real platform. The clauses are modeled on publicly discussed platform-policy patterns but are not legal advice.

clauses.title: One deduction per order and reason
clauses.text: QuickDrop will not apply the same deduction code to the same order more than once. If a duplicate is applied, the later charge must be reversed.

clauses.title: Late-delivery penalty cap
clauses.text: A late-delivery penalty may not exceed the greater of INR 100 or 25% of the order's total pay.
clauses.remedy: Refund the amount above the cap.

clauses.title: Cancellation penalty cap
clauses.text: A cancellation penalty may not exceed the greater of INR 50 or 10% of the order's total pay.
clauses.remedy: Refund the amount above the cap.

clauses.title: Restaurant delay protection
clauses.text: No late-delivery penalty applies when the restaurant preparation time exceeds 20 minutes.

clauses.title: Incentive payment
clauses.text: When a partner meets the published order target for an incentive, QuickDrop will pay the full incentive amount.

clauses.title: Earnings for delivered orders
clauses.text: Every order marked delivered must have at least one earning entry for the order.
clauses.remedy: Add the missing earning entry and pay the order.

clauses.title: Itemised deductions and human review
clauses.text: Every deduction must include an order reference, a published reason code, and an amount. Unclear deductions require human review before any claim is sent.
clauses.remedy: Ask the platform to itemise the deduction.
